description:
Use ChatGPT to explore NEWT, the smart and great-value travel app.
Just tell us your destination, travel dates, and budget in a conversation, and anyone can easily find overseas tour packages that suit them perfectly.
When you find a tour you’re interested in, simply tap “View on NEWT” to book smoothly and effortlessly.

Currently available in Japan only.

defaultPrompt: 家族旅行におすすめのハワイのツアーを探して
